usage: check_gpu.py [-h] [--steps STEPS] [--size SIZE] [--warmup WARMUP]
                    [--seed SEED] [--output OUTPUT]

Offline CUDA inspection and a small deterministic matmul/backward benchmark.
The default remains a one-step GPU check. For the P1 readiness gate, use
--steps 100 --size 1024 --warmup 10 --seed 42 --output <new-report.json>. No
project imports, downloads, pretrained models, or package installs are used.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --steps STEPS
  --size SIZE
  --warmup WARMUP
  --seed SEED
  --output OUTPUT  New JSON report path; existing reports are never
                   overwritten.
